glosses: A stupid, obnoxious, pathetic, or otherwise contemptible person.

examples.text: The poor schmo would immediately break down and confess that he did a lot of other bad things as well.

word_linkages.word: not the sharpest knife in the drawer

glosses: Any average Joe; any Joe Schmoe.

examples.text: Of his early childhood, he told the Deseret News of Salt Lake City: “I'm a schmo. My family never made more than $25,000 a year. We're all bakers for generations.”
